spans.s: वृंहित n. The same as बृंहित q.v.
वृंत n. 1. The foot-stalk of a leaf or fruit, वृंताच्छ्लथं हरति पुष्पमनोकहानाम् R.v.69; 2. the stand of a water-jar; 3. a nipple.
वृंद n. A heap, a multitude, a large number, यो वृंदानि त्वरयति पथि श्राम्यतां प्रोषितानाम् Megh.ii.36, R.xii.102.
वृंदा f. 1. The holy basil; 2. name of a forest near Gokula, Bh.V.iv.5.
वृंदा-वन n. the same as बृंदा (2) q.v., R.vi.50.
वृंदार a. (f. रा) 1. Large, great; 2. beautiful, attractive, pleasing.
वृंदार a. (f. रा) 1. Large, great; 2. beautiful, attractive, pleasing.
वृंदारक (I) a. (f. रका or रिका) 1. Large, great; 2. handsome, beautiful, attractive; 3. respectable, venerable.
वृंदारक (II) m. 1. A god, a deity, नतनिखिलवृंदारकवृतः Bh.V.iv.5; 2. (at the end of a compound) the chief of anything.
वृंदारक (I) a. (f. रका or रिका) 1. Large, great; 2. handsome, beautiful, attractive; 3. respectable, venerable.
वृंदारक (I) a. (f. रका or रिका) 1. Large, great; 2. handsome, beautiful, attractive; 3. respectable, venerable.
वृंदिष्ठ a. (f. ष्ठा) 1. Very great; 2. very beautiful, (super. of वृंदार q.v.).
वृंदिष्ठ a. (f. ष्ठा) 1. Very great; 2. very beautiful, (super. of वृंदार q.v.).
वृंदीयस् a. (f. सी) 1. Larger, greater; 2. more beautiful, (compar. of वृंदार q.v.).
वृंदीयस् a. (f. सी) 1. Larger, greater; 2. more beautiful, (compar. of वृंदार q.v.).
